headline: KFC India drops PepsiCo as its beverage partner
hook: KFC ends four-decade partnership with Pepsi
summary: KFC India has officially ended its 40-year partnership with PepsiCo to switch its beverage supply to Coca-Cola. The transition is expected to be completed across all KFC outlets in India shortly. This shift aligns KFC's beverage offerings with other major QSR chains in the country that already partner with Coca-Cola. The move marks a significant change in the supply chain landscape for the fast-food giant.
why_it_matters: Varun Beverages faces volume pressure; QSR chains see menu changes.
winners_losers: Coca-Cola gains / PepsiCo and Varun Beverages hurt

headline: KFC ends long-term partnership with PepsiCo to serve Coca-Cola
hook: KFC switches beverage supplier from Pepsi to Coke
summary: KFC has announced a transition to Coca-Cola as its exclusive beverage partner, ending a decades-long relationship with PepsiCo. The change will be implemented across KFC locations, though the financial terms of the new agreement were not disclosed. This shift impacts the distribution volume for PepsiCo in the quick-service restaurant segment. For Indian investors, this highlights the intense competition between global beverage giants for market share in the fast-food space.
why_it_matters: Changes in beverage partnerships impact margins for Indian QSR franchise operators.

headline: Restaurants hit with Rs 25,000 crore tax notices
summary: The Directorate General of GST Intelligence has issued notices to major restaurant chains and food aggregators regarding unpaid taxes. The tax authorities are investigating the classification of services and alleged non-payment of GST on certain supplies. This move targets large-scale operators and platforms that have seen rapid growth in the post-pandemic period. For retail investors, this represents a significant regulatory risk that could compress margins for listed food and delivery companies.
whats_next: Legal challenges or settlement discussions by restaurant operators
why_it_matters: Restaurant profit margins may shrink due to tax liabilities
